idea-plugin.name: Regex Named Group Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Shows the name of every named group ((?<year>\d{4})) inline, right on the line of any Java or Kotlin regex literal that has one -- no need to open a separate tool window just to remember what a pattern's groups are called.

A tool window (reusing Regex Preview Companion's own matching engine) lets you test a pattern against real sample text and see every named group's actual extracted value per match (year: "2024"), not just the overall match highlighted.

An invalid pattern shows the real PatternSyntaxException message instead of just going blank, and a pattern with zero named groups shows no inlay at all -- never a false hint on an ordinary string.

100% local -- no network call, no account, no telemetry.
